name: Monetizze
description: Monetizze is a versatile payment platform that also integrates affiliate marketing. It allows users to become either product creators or affiliates, enabling the sale of digital and physical products. With Monetizze, you can manage your payments, subscriptions, and affiliate relationships in one place, making it ideal for businesses looking to sell info products, physical items, or run affiliate programs.

events.d: Get all transactions, filtering by product, sales code (transaction), sale start date, completion date, status, payment method with the possibility of paginating the results.
